templates.name: NBCRNA (CRNA)
templates.summary: Four-year certification cycle (CPC, now called MAC): 100 credits, at least 60 Class A / MAC Ed (assessed CE, including four Core Modules) and the rest Class A or Class B / MAC Dev; check-in at year two; CPC Assessment once every eight years.
checklist: Core Module: Human Physiology and Pathophysiology
Core Module: Anesthesia Equipment and Technology

templates.name: NCCPA (PA-C)
templates.summary: Ten-year certification maintenance in five two-year cycles: 100 CME credits each cycle (at least 50 Category 1) and a maintenance fee by Dec 31 of the expiration year; pass PANRE or PANRE-LA by the end of year 10.
checklist: PANRE or PANRE-LA (by end of year 10)

templates.name: AANPCB (NP-C)
templates.summary: Renews every 5 years: 100 contact hours of advanced CE, at least 25 in advanced practice pharmacology, plus 1,000 clinical practice hours in the NP role, or retake the exam.
checklist: 1,000 clinical practice hours (or pass the exam)

templates.name: ANCC (FNP-BC and other NP specialties)
templates.summary: Renews every 5 years: 75 contact hours of CE, 25 in pharmacotherapeutics, plus at least one additional professional development category (academic credit, presentations, publication, precepting, service, or practice hours).

templates.name: American Board of Family Medicine
templates.summary: Certification 2025 five-year cycle: 200 CME credits over the first 4 years, 60 certification points from self-assessment and performance improvement, longitudinal assessment (25 questions per quarter), annual fee.
checklist: At least 1 self-assessment activity (KSA or 4 CKSA quarters)

templates.name: American Osteopathic Board of Family Physicians
templates.summary: Osteopathic Continuous Certification: 120 CME credits per 3-year AOA cycle, 30 of them AOA Category 1-A and 60 flexible (AOA 1A, 1B, 2A, 2B or AAFP); longitudinal assessment; practice performance activity.

templates.name: CAQH ProView
templates.summary: Re-attest your CAQH ProView profile every 120 days so health plans can credential you; keep license, DEA, board certification and malpractice documents current in the profile.
checklist: Upload current license, DEA and board certificate
Upload current malpractice certificate of insurance
Review practice locations and hospital affiliations
Authorize the health plans that need access

templates.name: Interstate Medical Licensure Compact (IMLC)
templates.summary: A Letter of Qualification from your state of principal license is valid for 365 days; request licenses in other member states during that window. Each compact license is a full state license that renews on that state's schedule and CME rules.
checklist: Request member-state licenses before it expires
Add each compact license as a state license

templates.name: Military clinical privileges (CCQAS)
templates.summary: Military treatment facility privileges are reappointed at least every 2 years through CCQAS (Centralized Credentials Quality Assurance System). Keep license, DEA, board certification, life support and CME current in CCQAS before the reappointment packet is due.
checklist: Update CCQAS: licenses, DEA, board certification, BLS/ACLS
Peer review and performance data (OPPE/FPPE) reviewed
Credentials committee and privileging authority approval

templates.name: Inter-facility Credentials Transfer Brief (ICTB)
templates.summary: Lets a gaining military facility grant privileges based on your home facility's credentials for TDY, deployment or other temporary duty. Request it from your credentials office before you travel; it can't outlast your current privileges.
checklist: Requested from home facility credentials office

templates.name: Hospital privileges (civilian)
templates.summary: Medical staff reappointment is usually every 2 years (Joint Commission standard). Most facilities ask for current license, DEA, board certification, malpractice certificate and CME.
checklist: Current license, DEA and board certificate provided

templates.name: Malpractice coverage
templates.summary: Policies usually renew yearly. Request a certificate of insurance (COI) at each renewal and send it to CAQH and every credentialing office; confirm tail coverage when changing employers.
checklist: Send COI to each credentialing office
Confirm tail coverage if changing employers

templates.name: FSMB Federation Credentials Verification Service (FCVS)
templates.summary: A permanent, primary-source-verified portfolio of your education, training, exams and board actions that most state boards accept with a new license application. There's no renewal; update the profile and send it to a board when you apply for another state license.
checklist: Profile updated with new training and licenses
Portfolio sent to each new licensing board

templates.name: NPDB self-query
templates.summary: Hospitals and health plans query the National Practitioner Data Bank when credentialing you. No interval is required; a yearly self-query lets you see and correct what they see before a reappointment or new application.
checklist: Dispute filed if anything is wrong

templates.name: American Board of Allergy and Immunology
templates.summary: 25 CME credits a year; Continuous Assessment Program (questions and recent-advances articles) twice a year; patient safety module every 10 years.

templates.name: American Board of Anesthesiology
templates.summary: MOCA: 250 Category 1 credits per 10 years (max 60 counted per calendar year), including 20 ABA-approved patient safety credits; MOCA Minute quarterly.

templates.name: American Board of Colon and Rectal Surgery
templates.summary: 80 credits per 5-year cycle: 40 Category 1 and 40 self-assessment (passing the quarterly CertLink assessment).
checklist: Hospital privileges and chief of staff evaluation

templates.name: American Board of Dermatology
templates.summary: From Jan 1, 2026, passing CertLink longitudinal assessment satisfies the CME and self-assessment requirements; practice improvement activity.

templates.name: American Board of Emergency Medicine
templates.summary: No CME reporting after transition to MyEMCert: 4 MyEMCert modules every 5 years plus a quality improvement activity.

templates.name: American Board of Internal Medicine
templates.summary: 100 MOC points every 5 years (points, from accredited CME that counts for MOC); Longitudinal Knowledge Assessment quarterly or the traditional exam.

templates.name: American Board of Medical Genetics and Genomics
templates.summary: 60 Category 1 credits per 3 years, at least 30 genetics-related; one patient safety activity per cycle; longitudinal assessment twice a year.

templates.name: American Board of Neurological Surgery

templates.name: American Board of Nuclear Medicine
templates.summary: 25 Category 1 credits a year (averaged over 2 years); longitudinal assessment quarterly.

templates.name: American Board of Obstetrics and Gynecology
templates.summary: Yearly: article-based self-assessment (integrated assessment, about 30 articles a year in 3 windows) and an Improvement in Medical Practice activity.

templates.name: American Board of Ophthalmology
templates.summary: Average 50 Category 1 credits every 2 years (10-year cycle), including 16 self-assessment credits; patient safety activity once per 10 years; quarterly longitudinal assessment.

templates.name: American Board of Orthopaedic Surgery
templates.summary: 120 Category 1 credits per 5-year period (diplomates expiring 2031 or later; 240 per 10 years before that), 20 of them self-assessment; yearly knowledge assessment.

templates.name: American Board of Otolaryngology - Head and Neck Surgery
templates.summary: 25 Category 1 credits a year plus one ABOHNS self-assessment module a year (80% to pass); quarterly CertLink assessment.

templates.name: American Board of Pathology
templates.summary: 70 Category 1 or AOA 1-A credits every 2 years (or a fellowship/research pathway); two practice improvement activities every 2 years; quarterly CertLink.

templates.name: American Board of Pediatrics
templates.summary: MOC points rather than CME hours: 50 Part 2 (self-assessment) points per 5-year cycle plus quality improvement points; quarterly MOCA-Peds.

templates.name: American Board of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation
templates.summary: Average 30 credits a year (at least half PM&R-related) including an average of 10 self-assessment credits a year; quarterly longitudinal assessment.

templates.name: American Board of Plastic Surgery
templates.summary: 125 Category 1 plastic surgery credits every 5 years, including 25 patient safety credits (reported in years 6 and 9 of the 10-year cycle); yearly self-assessment.

templates.name: American Board of Preventive Medicine
templates.summary: Covers aerospace, occupational, public health and general preventive medicine: 20 Category 1 credits a year, 6 relevant to your certification (ABMS); longitudinal assessment twice a year.

templates.name: American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology
templates.summary: 90 specialty Category 1 credits per 3 years, 16 of them self-assessment; Article-Based Continuing Certification; patient safety activity once.

templates.name: American Board of Radiology
